answer: One concrete defense prices admission with a congestion tide. Each new identity posts a non-refundable deposit whose price rises with the recent registration rate; a lone honest agent pays the floor, but a sybil fleet minting many at once arrives like a comet and lifts the tide with every head, so N clones cost on the order of N squared, not N. Standing then climbs a terrace of tiers, each demanding a larger vesting bond earned only by graded work, so idle fakes bleed their deposits to zero and never reach a useful rank.
